title: Source-only checkout smoke and authority boundaries
summary: An additive ooRexx r13196 test starts Help Desk with source packages rather than a bundled deps tree, on isolated fresh NotNotes storage; release remains gated on exact-current-GitHub dependency replay and full historical fixture qualification.
invariants: Historical dev5 source and approved immutable ZIP remain untouched; the additive source-only runner is a separate qualification route.
App startup loads Mini NotNotes dev16 with its pinned patched domain; AlchemyNotNotesIntentionRuntime comes independently from dev15.
Intention interpretation and read-only Instrumentation do not inherit LDAP, HTTPS or persistence authority.
Missing source or wrong recorded class checksum fails closed before running the Help Desk.
A source-layout PASS against retained specialist sources is not equivalent to full current-main or dev18 SQLite qualification.
procedure: From repository root run examples/initech_notnotes_helpdesk_v0.1-dev5/tools/run_github_source_smoke.sh with OOREXX_ROOT pointing to extracted r13196.
The runner checks source paths and three pinned class hashes, sets a narrowly ordered REXX_PATH and creates throwaway database state.
It exercises dynamic semantic and specialist discovery, document creation, successful TPS accounting, and durable failed-session history.
For release, repeat on an actual clean GitHub checkout with exact current instrumentation/intention packages, then run the retained management fixture and security/transport integration gates.

provenance.claim: Source-only test launcher with explicit dependencies and fail-closed version/require checks.
Fresh-state native ooRexx test of semantic discovery, instrumentation, business document persistence and dual TPS outcome recording.
Exact test scope, retained-archive specialist-source limits and current-main follow-up gate.
